hook: Seize the shop's best units onto your own shelf, let them age, then smuggle them back cheap.
loop: Herons Seize shop units into your Customs House each turn.
Goods age on the shelf; otters buy them back as Contraband.
Grisel fields shelf copies, and Contraband payoffs stack late.

growth.line: Shelf goods gain each turn; Contraband grows per buy-back; Start of Combat payoffs multiply late.

feel.early: A persistent freeze and cheap 2-gold buy-backs.
feel.mid: Hold or run: age the shelf or grow Contraband.
feel.late: Grisel, Wenna and the Auctioneer stack huge fights.

stars.why: Turns the shelf into an army at Start of Combat.
Launder your own unit to replay its When played effect.
Steals copies of what it kills onto your shelf.

card_short.u01: First hit on it redirects to the attacker's neighbour.
card_short.u02: When played: Seize a shop unit to your Customs House.
card_short.u03: Start of Turn: may Seize a unit.
card_short.u04: Start of Turn: Customs House units gain +1/+1 permanently.
card_short.u05: Grows itself and each Contraband unit you play.
card_short.u06: When played: Seize your own unit; it gains +2/+2.
card_short.u07: End of Turn: may Seize a unit or the spell.
card_short.u08: Each buy-back buffs it and all your Contraband.
card_short.u09: Start of Combat: grows for each Customs House unit.
card_short.u10: Customs House holds one more; its units count for triples.
card_short.u11: End of Turn: buffs all your Contraband units.
card_short.u12: Selling Contraband pays 1 extra gold, twice a turn.
card_short.u13: Burns a shelf unit; your biggest unit gains its stats.
card_short.u14: Contraband When played effects trigger twice.
card_short.u15: Start of Combat: Contraband grows per Customs House unit.
card_short.u16: Start of Combat: hits across twice; kills become shelf copies.
card_short.u17: Start of Combat: summons Contraband copies of your shelf units.
card_short.u18: Start of Combat: Contraband grows with the game's buy-backs.
card_short.u19: Start of Turn: auctions oldest shelf unit; Contraband gains half.

builds.name: Bonded warehouse
builds.line: Keep the shelf full and aged; Grisel fields copies in empty slots.

builds.name: Free traders
builds.line: Buy back every turn; Kit, Molly and Nan grow your Contraband.

builds.name: The informer's replay
builds.line: Ned and Dunmore replay any tribe's When played effect for 2 gold.

liked: All three: no tribe uses the shop itself; the shelf plays unlike anything.
Grisel is everyone's standout: seized goods march out as a second board.
worries: Grisel with Wenna and Nan stacks far above target; Nyx's Seized spell unclear.
Watch flags: Auctioneer's geometric growth, Keeper's free triples, Fence profit, Dunmore replay loops.
changed: Grisel's copies are Contraband, arrive first, and fire their own Start of Combat.
Tide-Waiter and Nyx Seize optionally, so holders keep shelf stock they want.
Tibby's redirect now trips the attacker into its own neighbour.
verdict: Rated 7.3 fun and 8 distinct, it ranked second of its seed's three; for players who love shop tricks and combos.
